title: VK-only Measured Value parser-depth sequence with complete quality fields
purpose: Exercise a measurement information-object path distinct from command and interrogation paths, including IOA, normalized value, and quality descriptor fields within a consistent I-frame.
expected_behavior: The server should parse or safely reject one complete measured-value object and its quality descriptor after the link is ready. The distinct type, COT, IOA, value, and quality fields provide parser-depth mutation points without depending on a missing field.
issue_safety_notes: The sequence is guided by reports involving deep information-object and time-related parser paths, while remaining a complete bounded measurement analogue. It does not copy the reported Clock Synchronization stream or either GHSA payload, and no specific vulnerability outcome is asserted.
